title: [Builder] Refuse an AUDIO_UNIT sampling_rates list the processor's microprogram cannot walk (more than 8 rates)

milestone.title: Software Defined Stack
milestone.description: Every aspect of the milan stack should be at compile time software definable.

body:
[A10] Found by the whole-project assessment of Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan#51 (owner directive of 2026-09-19: a processor defect is judged in the whole parent project and each repository gets a ticket for the part it owns).
## Objective and evidence

The protocol processor now checks SET_SAMPLING_RATE against the AUDIO_UNIT's
`sampling_rates` list (protocol-processor #51, pinned by the lane A139 parent
commit). Its microprogram can only address the image with immediates, so its
contract with the image is rule L10 of its `docs/architecture/07_memory_maps.md`
section 3.1:
- The list sits at `sampling_rates_offset` 144. This builder always writes
  144 (`avdecc/aem_descriptors.py` `d_audio_unit`).
- The list holds at most **8** entries. A rate listed past the eighth is
  refused. That fails closed, but it answers a controller that asks for a
  rate the descriptor advertises with BAD_ARGUMENTS, against Milan v1.2
  Section 5.3.3.3.

The builder bounds neither the length nor the content of
`clocking.audio_unit_rates_hz`:
- `sw/builder/endstation_builder.py` `_load_clocking` copies the list as
  given (`audio_unit_rates_hz=[int(r) for r in ...]`) and checks only that
  `sampling_rate_hz` is in it.
- `d_audio_unit` emits every entry verbatim.

Today's five tracked configs are well inside the bound. `endstation_arty_current`
lists `[48000, 96000, 192000]`, and the other four list `[48000]`, as the
images `avdecc/gen_aemi_image.py` builds from them show. No shipping image is
affected today.

## Acceptance

1. `_load_clocking` raises `ConfigError` for an `audio_unit_rates_hz` list
   with more than 8 entries, naming the processor's walk bound and its L10
   rule, and for a list with a duplicate entry.
2. `sw/builder/test_builder.py` gains gate 36a: a negative case for each
   refusal, and the five tracked configs still build.
3. The bound lives in one place on this side (a named constant next to
   `BASE_RATE_HZ`), with a comment pointing at the processor rule it mirrors.

Out of scope: the planned marks for advertised rates the fabric cannot run
(#399, closed, decided), and any change to the rates the shipping configs
advertise.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
